answer: Sybil farms flood attest slots because a new key is almost free. Each applicant posts 88 locked units at one bonded wharf locker and must drop a numbered marble down a 40-meter timed chute only when a shared 6-second pulse beacon fires. Transit must land in 11.2-12.8 seconds and is hashed with pubkey and the pulse nonce. Peers recompute the transit hash and refuse a second marble that shares a locker, co-signer, or refund path. A late or early transit burns 22 units and cools the key for four epochs; a reused marble-id or a second miss empties the locker and bars the key for ten epochs.
